pages.text: Red Matter Armor is the upgraded matter armor. Combine each Dark Matter piece with Red Matter to make its Red Matter version.$(br2)It behaves exactly like Dark Matter Armor but is tougher: the full set reduces incoming damage by roughly $(l)63%$() and each piece blocks more flat damage per hit, especially against explosions. It is also fireproof and never loses durability.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Damage that bypasses armor is not reduced.$(li)The flat per-hit blocking is higher than the Dark Matter set, so it protects better against many small hits and bursts.$(li)Only wearing some pieces gives a smaller total reduction.
